forge_threads_scope_consistency_check.name: forge_threads_scope_consistency_check
forge_threads_scope_consistency_check.value:
("forge_threads"."scope" = 'org' AND "forge_threads"."project_id" IS NULL AND "forge_threads"."run_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("forge_threads"."scope" = 'project' AND "forge_threads"."project_id" IS NOT NULL AND "forge_threads"."run_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("forge_threads"."scope" = 'run' AND "forge_threads"."project_id" IS NOT NULL AND "forge_threads"."run_id" IS NOT NULL)

notification_targets_scope_user_check.name: notification_targets_scope_user_check
notification_targets_scope_user_check.value: ("notification_targets"."scope" = 'org' AND "notification_targets"."user_id" IS NULL) OR ("notification_targets"."scope" = 'user' AND "notification_targets"."user_id" IS NOT NULL)

personas_scope_project_check.name: personas_scope_project_check
personas_scope_project_check.value: ("personas"."scope" = 'org' AND "personas"."project_id" IS NULL) OR ("personas"."scope" = 'project' AND "personas"."project_id" IS NOT NULL)
